name: fantasy-football-manager
description: ESPN HTTP season transactions and browser draft tools for Codex, with approval modes and per-team limits. Version 0.4.0 release candidate.

interface.shortDescription: Manage ESPN drafts and season transactions within saved limits.
interface.longDescription: The v0.4.0 release candidate adds HTTP season lineups, acquisitions, waiver claims, drops, IR moves, and optional verified week rollover. It uses a protected session file without a browser runtime. Draft operation retains the browser adapter. Saved modes and limits control each transaction. Pending waivers require ownership confirmation. This candidate is not yet published. Live HTTP write acceptance remains pending. Trade execution is unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Connect my ESPN draft and check automation limits.
Run continuous draft simulations and automatic picks.
Connect my ESPN season through HTTP and check action limits.
